Quick start

Record orders from Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram or phone calls in one place.

  • Add customer and delivery details
  • Track confirmation, shipping and delivery
  • Keep COD and return notes
  • Copy Bangla message templates

Today’s workflow

1. Enter each new order.

2. Confirm it with the customer.

3. Update status when the parcel moves.

4. Reconcile delivery and COD with your courier statement.
